evals.prompt: Add feedback to an API-backed save mutation using the existing React Toastify setup. Show a translated success toast only after the request succeeds, show a useful failure message for transport errors, preserve field validation errors inline, and avoid duplicate notifications.
evals.expected_output: Mutation-owned Toastify feedback with centralized container reuse, translated success/error messages, separation of field errors from transport failures, and duplicate prevention.
expectations: Success feedback is emitted only from confirmed mutation success and uses the existing centralized container.
Field validation remains inline while transport/domain failure gets one concise actionable notification.
The implementation has a single notification owner and prevents duplicate success/error toasts.

evals.prompt: Test a long-running file export that shows toast progress and then resolves or fails. Use the existing frontend test runner and assert user-visible notification behavior without depending on Toastify internals.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic notification test covering loading-to-success/error transitions, visible roles/text, cleanup, and existing provider/timer conventions.
expectations: The test renders the existing toast container/harness and asserts visible notification text or roles.
The test covers progress resolution and failure paths without inspecting Toastify implementation internals.
Timers and notification state are reset or cleaned up so the test remains isolated.
